title: Vault channel limits
description: The limits of the Vault channel (limits.json) that the engine and the Vault both apply, so neither can change one alone. Sizes are the most the Vault must carry; rates are the engine's, and the Vault may apply lower ones of its own. Limits only the engine and the page apply stay in the contract's table. See CONTRACT.md, Vault channel, Limits.

unit.description: BYTES: a message's size on the wire. SECONDS: a time. COUNT: a number of links, sessions or handshakes.
